    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "route < OF route < VL rupta (via) 'broken (road)'; harvest < OE hærfest 'autumn, harvest-time'",
    "reading": "A broken way through the season of gathering: passage after rupture, then the taking-in of ripe things.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "la", "ang"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Trésor de la langue française informatisé",
    "confidence": 0.92
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "route 91 = 'root' + 'nine-one'; harvest = 'harvest' / 'harvested'",
    "reading": "Root-nine-one: the hidden root of the ninth gate; harvest as the reaping of what was sown in the cycle.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.63
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "route ~ roue (fr) 'wheel'; harvest ~ hiver (fr) by sound-shift toward the cold season after gathering",
    "reading": "The wheel turns into winter: motion becomes the season after abundance, when the field is emptied.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.41
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "ROUTE HARVEST -> A HOVER? T?; partial anagrammatic pull: route / tore; harvest / re-hast",
    "reading": "A torn path and a hurried reaping: the road is undone, the crop taken in haste.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.28
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "R.O.U.T.E. = Return Of Unknown Tracks Everywhere; H.A.R.V.E.S.T. = Hidden Abundance Revealed, Very Endingly Sown, Taken",
    "reading": "A formula of concealed abundance: the track returns, and what was hidden is finally gathered.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.22
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "R = turning; O = enclosure; U = vessel; T = cross; E = opening; 9 = completion; 1 = unity",
    "reading": "Turning within an enclosure, crossed and opened, then completed and made one: a sealed cycle of gathering.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.35
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "9 = completion / end of a cycle; 1 = unity / beginning; 91 = 9+1 or 9×1, a closed threshold",
    "reading": "Completion joined to unity: the end and the beginning meet at the threshold before the harvest.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.58
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "harvest < OE hærfest 'autumn'; route as a path of travel, from OF route 'road'",
    "reading": "The road of autumn: a journey whose meaning is ripening, then cutting, then storage.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "ang"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Chambers Dictionary of Etymology",
    "confidence": 0.9
  }
]
